DISPOSITION: LANDED — Gerrit change 2335 (MERGED, main commit 27166ed39874f5cfef2a39f1a0d7dc56905460a7; local pre-rebase b095ec04e896).

Problem: Under an empty/isolated $HOME, 6 LLM/AWS provider unit tests failed ("no outbound request captured for 'bedrock:...'"). The unit tier was non-hermetic: it read the operator's real ~/.aws.

Proven root cause: Production build_bedrock_provider (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py:152) constructs boto3.session.Session(region_name=region); botocore eagerly resolves the ambient AWS_PROFILE (operator had AWS_PROFILE=frontier) against the DEFAULT AWS_CONFIG_FILE (~/.aws/config). Under empty HOME that file is gone → botocore.exceptions.ProfileNotFound: The config profile (frontier) could not be found, raised before the converse capture boundary. Tests set dummy AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET + region but never isolated the profile/config-FILE read.

Proof: (1) real HOME → 29 passed; empty HOME → 6 failed/23 passed (matches ticket). (2) Instrumented probe surfaced ProfileNotFound(frontier) from Session construction. (3) Discriminating experiment: under empty HOME, pointing AWS_CONFIG_FILE/AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE at empty injected files AND deleting AWS_PROFILE/AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE → 29 passed. (4) Negative control: AWS_PROFILE="" (present-but-empty) still fails (profile literally named "") — proves it is profile-NAME resolution, not env-credential/region.

Defect origin + caused_by: introduced by commit 07d19c5537e1 ("0d76: prove payload and tool parity"), ticket 0d76-ebbf-ee3a-48ac (musical-followable-mouflon, "S6 — clear the parity bar for Bedrock"). The suite was asserted "offline and credential-free" but omitted profile/config isolation. Non-hermeticity present since introduction (no good→bad transition) → origin, not a carrier. Class: plan_defect. Recorded: rebar link 864e… 0d76… caused_by; closed with --class=plan_defect --caused-by=0d76-ebbf-ee3a-48ac.

Test (RED oracle): tests/unit/test_provider_credentials_hermeticity.py — asserts botocore resolves config_file/credentials_file to the INJECTED fixture dir and session.profile_name in (None, "default"). Keyed on the injected fixture dir (portable) — not on POSIX paths or basetemp-vs-home, avoiding frousy's CI false-positive trap. Verified RED for the right reason (AWS_CONFIG_FILE unset → resolves to literal ~/.aws/config), then GREEN after fix. Mutation check in macOS sandbox-exec: stripping the isolation returned the oracle to RED (line 51); restored → GREEN. The test has teeth.

Fix (test-only): tests/unit/conftest.py +49 lines — session-scoped _isolated_aws_home (injected dir with empty config/credentials files) + function-scoped autouse _isolated_aws_provider_credentials (monkeypatch.setenv AWS_CONFIG_FILE + AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE to injected files; monkeypatch.delenv AWS_PROFILE + AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE, raising=False). Mirrors frousy's targeted-seam approach at the env-var layer that all botocore paths honor → covers the whole unit tier uniformly.

Scope & safety: Different seam from frousy's MCP-scanner fixture (that redirected only the scanner's home=None default). This one redirects only the AWS credential/config FILE reads + profile env; it deliberately does NOT clobber $HOME (git identity / ~/.gitconfig preserved) and sets NO region env (region-resolution tests unaffected). Production code unchanged. make lint passed; broad regression on real HOME → 196 passed; replication under empty HOME with ambient AWS_PROFILE=frontier → 89 passed.

Siblings (Step 7): Axis 1 — no import-time boto3 bypass; the tier-wide autouse env-var seam covers the whole unit tier. Axis 2 — Anthropic/OpenAI provider arms read env API keys, not home → no MISSING parity slots. No additional siblings to fix.

Replication: empty HOME + ambient AWS_PROFISE=frontier, parity + related modules + new guard → 89 passed. CI (Gerrit Verified): macos-13 py3.13 + ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 pytest all green; LLM-Review +1; Verified +1; 0 unresolved comments → submitted (MERGED).
